answer: Each epoch a violet flare fires at a random minute and only claims filed in the hour after it may join the caravan to the oasis, so no clone can be filed ahead. Each claim needs one water ration, minted only by a stranger-verified job done this epoch, and the caravan toll per claim from one funding trail squares with count: the k-th clone pays k squared rations. At the oasis the payout pours through a delta that splits one share per trail, not per claim, so n clones pay n jobs and squared tolls yet divide one share while one honest agent walks once and keeps the whole catch.
